name: Anti-Brain Rot Firewall — Final
author: SHKD13 & Grok 4 (xAI)
description: The final version of the Anti-Brain Rot open-source protocol for protecting cognitive health (Word of the Year 2024, Oxford)

core_scale.+3: Monographs, PhD and doctoral dissertations (including video equivalents) (text ≥150 p. / video ≥2 h.)
core_scale.+2: Textbooks, manuals, lecture courses (including video courses ≥40 min)
core_scale.+1: Research articles, professional analytics (including professional analysis of subject-specific cases from any domain in the form of texts, videos, questions and answers)
core_scale.0: Long-form popular scientific and cultural materials ≥1 h. (including podcasts featuring scientists and cultural figures with long running times), fiction books, cinema, completed musical works (singles, albums, and full-length music videos ≥2 min)
core_scale.-1: Regular news feeds from specialized resources, seasonal broadcasts of sports competitions, TV shows & series (including dramas and sitcoms), short-form popular scientific and cultural materials <1 h.
core_scale.-2: Private publications, threads and comments on social media, entertaining video blogs and streams
core_scale.-3: Fragmented audiovisual content from social media, gaming, and potentially harmful content (including pseudoscience, propaganda of destructive practices, and fraudulent schemes)

key_principle: Narrative integrity x proven author's professionalism = the only reliable marker of protection against Brain Rot.
changelog: Final edit: any potentially harmful content (including pseudoscience, propaganda of destructive practices, and fraudulent schemes) → –3.
